listening.title: Finding the gap in the bank reconciliation

lines.speaker: Mai (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Tuấn, the cash in the general ledger is still different from the bank statement. How big is the gap?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Accountant)
lines.text: It's about fifty-two million dong. I've found most of the reasons already.

lines.speaker: Mai (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Good. Can you walk me through them?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Accountant)
lines.text: First, there's a deposit in transit of forty-five million. We recorded it on June thirtieth, but the bank received it on July first.

lines.speaker: Mai (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: So that's just a timing difference. What about the rest?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Accountant)
lines.text: About three hundred thousand is bank charges. We haven't recorded them yet.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Accountant)
lines.text: I think it's a transposition error. One invoice was six point nine million, but we entered nine point six.

lines.speaker: Mai (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Please fix it and run the trial balance again. Everything should tie out before Friday.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Accountant)
lines.text: Okay. I'll also check the intercompany balance with the Hà Nội branch today.
